attributes.title: 2027 ADEA Annual Session & Exhibition
attributes.summary:
The 2027 ADEA Annual Session & Exhibition takes place March 13 to 16, 2027 at the Hyatt Regency Chicago. Its theme is "Vision Elevated, Impact Amplified." The American Dental Education Association runs the meeting for the people who teach and train the dental workforce.

ADEA invites faculty, administrators, staff, researchers, clinicians, students, residents, fellows and community partners. For dentists and hygienists who teach, it is the main national meeting on curriculum, assessment and academic leadership in dentistry.

The about page does not list fees or a CE credit statement yet. Questions about the meeting go to meetings@adea.org.
